projects.name: agent-browser
projects.description: Browser automation CLI for AI agents
projects.readmeExcerpt: agent browser Browser automation for AI agents: open pages, read them as an accessibility tree, and act on elements from the shell. agent browser is a native Rust CLI that gives an AI agent a browser it can drive one command at a time. snapshot returns the page as compact text with a ref such as @e1 for each element. The agent acts on a ref, reads the page again to check the result, and repeats. The browser stays open between commands, so each step is one short shell call. Install Homebrew: brew install agent browser , then agent browser install . Linux: agent browser install with deps also installs the browser's system libraries. No install: npx agent browser open example.com . Project installs, building from source, upgrade , and doctor are covered in Installation.
